scenarios.name: complete-physics-boundary-and-resumption-matrix
procedure: For each case create exact sealed input in a fresh project; verify frozen program/source/asset identity before evaluation.
At every frozen observation clock request the exact before/after state with inspect, then repeat with a new request ID and compare all defined fields.
Evaluate once directly to horizon, and independently in increasing frozen after clocks with returned run_id; close/reopen at first nonzero torque boundary and resume same actual run.
Compare source records, exact canonical hex/anchors/counts, bounded errors, independent quaternion/marker and COM oracles. Read self-frame variants at initial, reversal and completion clocks.
No sample-only split, hidden zero-crossing public event, future completion outside requested prefix or torque-induced translation anchor is permitted.

template_rules.$bundle_file: Read exact frozen files manifest and source/PNG bytes, seal unchanged bundle/0.2, verify independently frozen identity BEFORE dispatch. No ambient import.
template_rules.$capture: Use the actual barrier/byte-length field named here; it is captured evidence, not a guessed ID.
template_rules.$loop: Use zero-based iteration index and current exact returned byte offset; retain every fully materialized request.
template_rules.$response: Resolve exact named earlier actual response path; no alternative or fabricated identifier.
template_rules.namespaces: Every scenario, repair, stage, fault variant and chunk-size loop uses its own fresh project/store/request namespace. Templates retain all field values; replace only the documented namespace prefix to avoid accidental duplicate IDs.
template_rules.request_ref: Reuse complete named prior request including request_id; only explicit override test changes it.
template_rules.unexpected_outcomes: Retain actual failing outcome and input; correct only by reviewed new pre-implementation revision. Never retune expectations to candidate output.
